jobs.title: Project Engineering Manager - Core Spreads Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Location: Pratau, Germany

 On-site

 About the position 

 As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

 Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.

 Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.

 Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.

 Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.

 Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.

 Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.

 Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.

 Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.

 Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.

 Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.

 Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.

 Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.

 Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.

 Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.

 Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

 Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.

 Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.

 Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

 We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio. We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy. If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

 YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

 
 You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product andthe product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.

 You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.

 You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.

 You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements byresearching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.

 You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

 
 IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING:

 
 You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.

 You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.

 You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.

 You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.

 You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.

 You are fluent in written and spoken English.

 
 ALSO DESIRABLE:

 
 Your experience with products in computer vision, AI, or video management domains is a plus.

 
 WHAT WE OFFER:

 
 Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.

 Innovation where it matters - A challenging position in a company that is changing the world of video data: With you we will make history.

 Creative and entrepreneurial playground - Get a chance to be your own master, define your own tasks, actively contribute and implement your ideas. Grow yourself and grow the success of the company with direct influence from day one.

 Team spirit celebrates diversity - Numerous events to get to know the teams and meet our great visionaries.

 Flexible working hours - Trust-based and goal-oriented working culture.

 Benefits to smooth your ride in life - Public transport ticket with a 50% subsidy and a huge discount on Urban Sports Club memberships.

 Boost your learning – we’ll fund it - We offer a generous learning budget so you can improve your skills.

 Loft-office in central Berlin - With free drinks and a large balcony with barbecue.

 
 WHY YOU SHOULD WORK HERE:

 We are a diverse, ambitious team with a great passion for data privacy, generative AI and startups. Our office is in the heart of Berlin, one of the coolest, most vibrant cities worldwide. We enjoy teamwork and celebrating successes together. If you are looking for a new challenge with real impact from day one, check out our job openings and apply today!

Responsibilities

 We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.

 Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.

 You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.

 You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Delivery (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.

 Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.

 This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.

 Tasks

 
 Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.

 Help maintain and organize the product backlog.

 Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.

 Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.

 Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.

 Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.

 Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

 Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.

 Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.

 Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.

 Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.

 Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

 
 Requirements

 What we’re looking for 

 
 Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.

 Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.

 The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.

 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.

 Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.

 Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.

 A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.

 Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.

 
 Helpful, but not required 

 
 Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.

 Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.

 Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.

 Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.

 
 You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

 What success looks like within your first six months: 

 
 Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.

 Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.

 Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.

 Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.

 Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.

 The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.

 You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

 
 Benefits

 We offer an exciting environment at the interface between IT and entertainment and marketing as part of an ambitious, international and results-orientated team in a young startup.

 
 You work with an excellent international team with varied tasks with a wide range of great opportunities

 An attractive and competitive salary

 Monthly learning budget

 We are a startup in one of the cultural hubs in Berlin, you'll never get bored

jobs.description:
At AlixPartners, we tackle complex challenges by transforming insights into innovative solutions, delivering lasting value for businesses, their people, and the communities they serve. Our products are designed to drive meaningful impact, ensuring sustainable growth and success. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity of thoughts and experiences bring to our firm, and are committed to the perpetual enhancement of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone. 
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person and remote working. This role follows a different cadence to traditional consulting or on-site client presence. It follows a traditional product development cadence, while being expected to engage our users in appropriate situations such as business conferences and in-person workshops. 
What you'll do

You will translate complex capabilities into clear value narratives, building internal and external marketing programs This role spans the full Platforms portfolio, with responsibility for raising awareness holistically across all products and initiatives, not just individual releases. You will work hand-in-hand with the Product Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to turn feature releases into awareness moments, and usage gaps into engagement campaigns. 
Key Responsibilities

Product Branding and Content Development. 
Partner with Product Managers, industry and service lines, and the wider marketing team to define the market-facing identity of each product in the Platforms portfolio. Establish and maintain clear value propositions, positioning statements, and messaging frameworks aligned with the firm's wider brand proposition and visual identity standards. Drive the development of core go-to-market content, including digital assets and sales material, ensuring a cohesive product presence before and beyond any individual launch. Create high-quality product content including demos, feature walkthroughs, onboarding materials, and release announcements. Concept, brief and direct agency/contractors to produce video content to a professional standard. Maintain and improve internal knowledge bases, wiki pages, and public-facing product pages to ensure content stays current and accurate.
Internal Product Promotion and Awareness Build and execute internal marketing campaigns that drive product visibility, feature adoption, and top-of-mind awareness across business units and geographies. Ensure consistent messaging across channels. This includes firm-wide awareness initiatives that promote the Platforms portfolio as a whole, beyond individual product launches. 
Product Demos and Showcases Deliver live and recorded product demonstrations for internal stakeholders, new internal users, and leadership. Present new features in a way that connects directly to user needs and business outcomes. 
Stakeholder Engagement Build relationships with key stakeholders across the firm. Understand their workflows, pain points, and communication preferences. Translate that knowledge into targeted campaigns that resonate with specific user groups. 
Marketing Collaboration Serve as the primary bridge between the Platforms product team and the central marketing function, operating with a close dotted-line relationship to the marketing team. Co-develop campaigns, align on messaging, and coordinate on external and firm-wide product promotions. Ensure all firm-wide communications follow established marketing protocols and channel ownership. 
Strategy and Playbook Development Develop a structured awareness and adoption strategy for the Platforms portfolio. Build repeatable playbooks that can be applied across products and scaled as the portfolio grows. Translate strategy into actionable plans with clear milestones and ownership.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner Conversational AI (gn)
jobs.description:
Unser Kunde ist ein großer deutscher Dienstleistungskonzern mit einem sehr großen Endkundenstamm und hohem Serviceaufkommen am Telefon. Diesen Service entwickelt er mit KI und Automatisierung konsequent weiter: einfache Anliegen übernimmt zunehmend die Technologie, die Menschen konzentrieren sich auf das Komplexe. Wir suchen den Kopf, der diese KI-gestützte Contact-Center-Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb aufbaut und den telefonischen Kundenservice damit auf die nächste Stufe hebt.

 ​

 Deine Aufgaben 

 Mit direkter Berichtslinie zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice verantwortest Du die Lösung von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb und schlägst die Brücke zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Das beinhaltet im Detail:

 
 Du konzipierst die Lösung und treibst die Automatisierung im telefonischen Service voran.

 Du übersetzt die Anforderungen in klare User Stories für Voice- und Chatbots und verantwortest den Backlog.

 Du steuerst die Umsetzung Ende zu Ende, von Projektzielen und Budget bis zur Führung eines interdisziplinären, agilen Teams.

 Du führst Telefonie, CRM und Bots gemeinsam mit der IT zu einer Plattform zusammen und gestaltest ihr Zusammenspiel.

 Du hast den Markt im Blick, entscheidest über den Einsatz neuer Technologien und verantwortest Qualität und Effizienz im Kundenkanal.

 
 ​

 Dein Profil 

 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner / Produktmanager an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT, idealerweise im Bereich Voice oder Conversational AI.

 Du hast Voice-, Chat- oder Contact-Center-Lösungen umgesetzt, idealerweise KI-Projekte.

 Du kennst den telefonischen Kundenservice aus der Praxis und hast dort Verantwortung getragen.

 Du arbeitest agil, User Stories sind für Dich selbstverständlich; Zertifizierungen wie Scrum, PRINCE2 oder PMP sind ein Plus.

 
 ​

 Wir bieten 

 
 Eine Plattform, die Du gestaltest, nicht ein bestehendes System, das Du verwaltest.

 Verantwortung im Aufbau, mit eigenem Team, eigenem Budget und direktem Draht zur Bereichsleitung Kundenservice.

 Eine exponierte Rolle, die Service, Produkt und KI verbindet und Dich für die nächste Führungsaufgabe aufstellt.

 Ein attraktives, der Verantwortung entsprechendes Vergütungspaket

 
 ​

 Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss 

 Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst Du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach Deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch. Bitte lade aber vorher Deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

We're looking for someone to do something ambitious: transform how Apaleo handles fiscal and compliance requirements across global markets, moving from reactive, country-by-country firefighting to a scalable platform capability that makes expansion repeatable, fast, and low-risk.

 If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human, and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

 

 What You'll Be Up To

 

 This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. The work you drive directly determines how fast Apaleo can expand internationally. You will own the product vision, roadmap, and architectural direction for the entire Fiscal & Compliance domain, operating as a peer to our Product Compliance Leader, where they bring regulatory intelligence and you translate it into platform strategy and delivery.

 Fiscal framework vision & scalable market enablement 

 Define and drive the long-term architectural vision for how Apaleo handles fiscal compliance at scale, one that transforms new-market enablement from bespoke engineering projects into scalable, configuration-driven workflows. Own the investment case for this platform-level work, defend it against short-term feature pressure, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome: measurably faster and cheaper fiscal provider integrations and new country launches.

 Roadmap ownership & strategic prioritisation Own the Fiscal & Compliance product roadmap end-to-end: from regulatory signal to architectural decision to crew-level delivery. Make prioritisation trade-offs transparently, deciding when to take on a new country requirement, when to defer, and when to invest in foundational capability instead.

 Turf leadership & team development Lead and develop the Crew-level PM(s) within the turf, providing direction, coaching, and clear ownership boundaries. Depending on team shape and capacity, you may also directly own one of the crews, particularly where the work is foundational or tightly coupled to the vision.

 Cross-functional leadership Work as a peer with the Product Compliance Leader: they bring regulatory intelligence and country strategy; you translate that into product decisions and delivery. Collaborate with BD and CS to ensure the roadmap reflects commercial priorities.

 What You'll Bring to the Team

 

 Required Experience & Competencies

 
 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role owning a platform domain or complex infrastructure product area.

 Demonstrated experience driving platform-level investment decisions, not just feature delivery, but architectural thinking with multi-year consequences.

 Background in fiscal, financial, or compliance-adjacent product domains (fintech, ERP, tax-tech, PMS, or similar) to engage credibly with regulatory complexity, even if you're not a primary specialist.

 Intellectually honest about domain gaps, with a concrete plan to close them, comfortable working alongside a domain expert rather than needing to be one.

 Experience leading or mentoring other PMs, with a clear management or coaching track record.

 Strong prioritisation instincts under competing pressures, with a track record of defending foundational investment against short-term demands.

 Excellent communication skills, able to make complex platform trade-offs legible to engineers, senior leadership, and commercial stakeholders alike.

 
 Strongly preferred

 
 Prior exposure to hospitality technology or PMS platforms.

 Experience owning a compliance or fiscalization project through multiple market expansions.

 Familiarity with European fiscal regulatory landscape and what it takes to build compliant products across these markets.

 
 What early success looks like

 
 A fiscal integration framework vision is defined, socialised, and has engineering investment allocated to it.

 The time and cost of connecting a fiscal provider to a new market has measurably reduced.

 The team is operating with a forward-looking roadmap, not a reactive backlog.

 Platform investment and technical debt reduction are treated as explicit roadmap streams alongside regulatory delivery.
